newsitem.title: UK: FirstBus says to buy CentreWest.
newsitem.headline: FirstBus says to buy CentreWest.

text.p: Britain's FirstBus Plc said on Wednesday that it had conditionally agreed to acquire CentreWest for around 54 million stg.
FirstBus operates local bus services in west, central and south-east London.
FirstBus is offering 2.5 FirstBus shares for each CentreWest share held.

FirstBus said CentreWest would recommend the offer to its ordinary shareholders after its executive directors had given irrevocable undertakings in respect to their shares, which is around 68 percent of its issued capital.
Lazard Brothers is advising FirstBus on the deal.
Under the deal CentreWest's share capital has been valued at 24 million stg.
FirstBus has agreed to refinance CentreWest's net debt obligations including its loan stock for an amount not expected to exceed 30 million stg.
